a.lede: Francis Halzen of University of Wisconsin-Madison led development of IceCube Neutrino Observatory.
a.title: Neutrino physicist wins 2026 Nobel Physics Prize

b.lede: “Detecting a neutrino is like looking for a needle in a haystack,” says Juan Carlos Díaz Vélez, who breaks down why researchers are looking for the cosmic particles under the Antarctic ice.
b.title: A Scientist Working on the ‘IceCube’ Neutrino Detector Explains the Nobel Prize–Winning Technology
